note: SCORCH の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 炎上中の敵への攻撃力+6%、以降+4%/Lv(Lv9で+38%)。ボスにも有効。単独でも命中時に炎上を付与：確率はLv1で8%、以降+2%/Lv
en: Attack against burning enemies +6%, then +4%/Lv (+38% at Lv9). Also works on bosses. Can inflict burn on hit by itself: 8% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

note: FIRE WHIRL の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 炎上中の敵の近くにいる敵へ、1秒ごとに確率で炎上が移る(Lv1で15%、以降+3%/Lv)。風刃が炎上中の敵に当たると、周りの敵にも炎を運ぶ。単独でも命中時に炎上を付与：確率はLv1で8%、以降+2%/Lv
en: Every second, burn may spread from a burning enemy to a nearby enemy (15% at Lv1, +3 pp per additional Lv). Wind blades hitting burning enemies also spread fire to nearby enemies. Can inflict burn on hit by itself: 8% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

note: COMBUSTION の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 炎上中の敵に炎上を4回重ねると爆発し、周りの敵にダメージを与えて炎上させる(爆発した敵の炎上は消える)。威力と範囲はLvで増加。同じ敵の爆発は4秒(ボスは6秒)に1回。単独でも命中時に炎上を付与：確率はLv1で8%、以降+2%/Lv
en: Applying 4 burn stacks to a burning enemy triggers an explosion, damaging and burning nearby enemies (the exploding enemy's burn ends). Power and radius increase with Lv. Each enemy can explode once every 4s (6s for bosses). Can inflict burn on hit by itself: 8% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

note: PERMAFROST の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 冷えが重なるほど減速が強くなる：2回目から1回ごとに減速+3.5%(Lv9で+7.5%)、最大3回分。冷え時間+0.15秒/Lv。単独でも命中時に冷えを付与：確率はLv1で8%、以降+2%/Lv
en: Slow increases with chill stacks: starting from the 2nd stack, +3.5% slow per stack (+7.5% at Lv9), up to 3 additional stacks. Chill duration +0.15s/Lv. Can inflict chill on hit by itself: 8% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

note: GLACIER GUARD の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: このカードだけでもShieldを1つ持てる。敵を凍結させるか冷えを3回重ねるとShieldが1つ回復する(Lv1で19秒に1回、以降1秒ずつ短縮)。単独でも命中時に冷えを付与：確率はLv1で8%、以降+2%/Lv
en: This card alone lets you hold 1 Shield. Freezing an enemy or applying 3 chill stacks restores 1 Shield (once every 19s at Lv1, reduced by 1s per additional Lv). Can inflict chill on hit by itself: 8% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

note: SHATTER STRIKE の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 凍結中、または冷えが3回以上重なった敵に攻撃を当てると氷を砕く追撃(周りの敵にも半分)。凍結と冷えの重なりは消える。ボスは同じ条件で砕け、BREAKが溜まる(同じボスは8秒に1回)。威力とBREAKはLvで増加。単独でも命中時に冷えを付与：確率はLv1で8%、以降+2%/Lv
en: Hitting a frozen enemy or one with 3+ chill stacks triggers a shatter follow-up (half damage to nearby enemies). Freeze and chill stacks are removed. Bosses can also be shattered under the same conditions, building up BREAK (once every 8s per boss). Power and BREAK increase with Lv. Can inflict chill on hit by itself: 8% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

note: CONDUCTOR の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 落雷を受けた敵が2秒帯電し、帯電中の敵への攻撃力+6%(以降+4%/Lv)。冷え・凍結中の敵への落雷+8%(以降+4%/Lv)、連鎖も届きやすい。単独でも落雷が発生：確率はLv1で5%、以降+1%/Lv
en: Lightning strikes charge enemies for 2s. Attack against charged enemies +6%, then +4%/Lv. Lightning damage against chilled or frozen enemies +8%, then +4%/Lv, with easier chaining to them. Can trigger lightning by itself: 5% chance at Lv1, +1 pp per additional Lv.

note: VOLT SURGE の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 1回の攻撃の命中3回ごとに追加の落雷(最大3本)。多段攻撃や範囲攻撃と相性が良い。追加の落雷の威力は通常の65%(以降+5%/Lv)。単独でも落雷が発生：確率はLv1で5%、以降+1%/Lv
en: Every 3 hits from a single attack trigger an extra lightning strike (up to 3). Works well with multi-hit and area attacks. Extra strikes deal 65% of normal lightning damage, then +5 pp per additional Lv. Can trigger lightning by itself: 5% chance at Lv1, +1 pp per additional Lv.

note: JUDGMENT BOLT の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 落雷を重ねると雷力が溜まり、満タンで次の落雷が大落雷になる(周りにもダメージ・雑魚を一瞬停止・ボスはBREAKが溜まる)。必要な回数はLv1で10回(Lv9で6回)、威力はLv1で2.2倍(Lv9で3.8倍)。大落雷は4秒に1回まで。単独でも落雷が発生：確率はLv1で5%、以降+1%/Lv
en: Lightning strikes build charge. When full, the next strike becomes a Judgment Bolt, damaging nearby enemies, briefly stunning regular enemies, and building up BREAK on bosses. Requires 10 strikes at Lv1 (6 at Lv9); power ×2.2 at Lv1 (×3.8 at Lv9). At most once every 4s. Can trigger lightning by itself: 5% chance at Lv1, +1 pp per additional Lv.

note: SLIPSTREAM の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 走る速さに応じて風刃が強くなり、出やすくなる(40km/hから伸びて120km/hで最大)。最大で威力+14%・確率+1.5%、以降1Lvごとに+4%・+0.5%。単独でも風刃が発生：確率はLv1で6%、以降+2%/Lv
en: Wind blades grow stronger and trigger more often as you run faster (scaling from 40km/h to a maximum at 120km/h). At maximum speed, +14% power and +1.5 pp trigger chance, then +4% power and +0.5 pp chance per additional Lv. Can release wind blades by itself: 6% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

note: UPDRAFT の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 空中の敵(打ち上げた敵・飛ぶ敵)への攻撃力+6%(以降+4%/Lv)。自分も空中で当てると風の追撃(威力7.5、以降+1.5/Lv)。単独でも風刃が発生：確率はLv1で6%、以降+2%/Lv
en: Attack against airborne enemies (launched or flying) +6%, then +4%/Lv. Hitting them while airborne yourself triggers a wind follow-up (power 7.5, then +1.5/Lv). Can release wind blades by itself: 6% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv.

note: TEMPEST の説明(カード詳細・3択)
ja: 風刃が続けて飛ぶ：Lv1〜6で2本、Lv7〜9で3本。後の風刃の威力は30%(以降+3%/Lv)。単独でも風刃が発生：確率はLv1で6%、以降+2%/Lv。続けて飛ぶのは1秒に1回まで、ボスへのダメージは半分
en: Wind blades fire in succession: 2 at Lv1–6, 3 at Lv7–9. Follow-up blades deal 30% of normal damage, then +3 pp per additional Lv. Can release wind blades by itself: 6% chance at Lv1, +2 pp per additional Lv. Follow-up volleys trigger at most once per second and deal half damage to bosses.
